sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Consumer Defensive / Farm Products · Indonesia. PT Perusahaan Perkebunan London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the plantation business in Indonesia and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Oil Palm Products, Seeds, and Others. It offers crude palm oil, palm kernel oil, rubber, cocoa, tea, and oil palm seeds.
